description: Turn a JSON sample (or an array of samples of the same shape) into a JSON Schema draft 2020-12 and a TypeScript type. Infers required vs optional keys across samples, nullable fields, integer vs number, date/email/uri/uuid formats, and small enums. Use it to draft an MCP tool inputSchema from an example payload.

json.description: The JSON text. Free tier: 20,000 chars.

name: json_to_schema
